pairs.target: gōnglù chē tiānliàng hòu chūfā , rào gǔ de lù bǐ tǎ wéi gé chuāng kànjiàn de cháng .
pairs.english: The road cart left after dawn. The route around the valley was longer than it had looked through Tavi's window.
pairs.hanzi: 公路车天亮后出发，绕谷的路比塔维隔窗看见的长。

pairs.target: suǒdào yíduàn biàn guò de kōng chù , chē yào xiān xiàng běirào , guò yízuò jǐ zài liǎngbì jiān de shíqiáo , zài yán lìngyímiàn shānpō wǎnghuí zǒu .
pairs.english: To cross a gap covered in one cable stretch, the cart had to loop north first, cross a stone bridge squeezed between two cliffs, then come back along the opposite slope.
pairs.hanzi: 索道一段便过的空处，车要先向北绕，过一座挤在两壁间的石桥，再沿另一面山坡往回走。

pairs.target: tā jiāng shuǐhú dǐ zài xītóu , jǐcì kànjiàn tóng yízuò gāojià , què měicì dōu cóng bùtóng de shù hòu lùchū lái .
pairs.english: He braced his flask on his knees, seeing the same tower several times, each time emerging from behind different trees.
pairs.hanzi: 他将水壶抵在膝头，几次看见同一座高架，却每次都从不同的树后露出来。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng shuō bàngwǎn qián huí , ruò liú dé wǎn , biàn zài duìàn chīguòfàn zài gǎn zuìhòu yìbān , bù cuī chēfū pǎo .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng said they would return before dusk; if they stayed late, they would eat across the valley and catch the last cart, without rushing the driver.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡说傍晚前回，若留得晚，便在对岸吃过饭再赶最后一班，不催车夫跑。

pairs.target: tā dāying le , wǎng wài nuó le yìdiǎn . wēn xiù zuòzài duìmiàn , kàozhe zìjǐ de mùxiá bǔ jué , chē měi diān yíxià , tā tóudǐng nàgēn sōngkāi de fāzān jiù wǎng xiàhuá yìfēn , zhōngyú bèi ruǎn héng shēnshǒu jiē zhù .
pairs.english: He agreed and moved outward a little. Wenxiu slept opposite against her wooden case; with every jolt her loose hairpin slipped farther, until Ruan Heng reached to catch it.
pairs.hanzi: 他答应了，往外挪了一点。温岫坐在对面，靠着自己的木匣补觉，车每颠一下，她头顶那根松开的发簪就往下滑一分，终于被阮衡伸手接住。

pairs.target: dào shí bèi shí , zhǎng lún de wūzi xiān chūxiàn zài lùbiān , jiē tái fǎnér cáng zài hòutou .
pairs.english: At Shibei the wheel house appeared first beside the road, with the receiving platform hidden behind.
pairs.hanzi: 到石背时，掌轮的屋子先出现在路边，接台反而藏在后头。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yǐwéi cóng zhè yìbiān kàn huíqù , fēng zhàn zǒng gāi biànxiǎo , kě huòchǎng dǐngshàng de gāojià réng gāogāo lì zhe , kǎobǐng pù què zěnme yě zhǎo búdào .
pairs.english: Tavi expected Wind Trestle to look smaller from this side, but the towers above the freight yard still stood tall, while the bakery was nowhere to be found.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维以为从这一边看回去，风栈总该变小，可货场顶上的高架仍高高立着，烤饼铺却怎么也找不到。

pairs.target: tā cháo nà pái wūdǐng diǎn le liǎnghuí , wēn xiù xǐnglái , gàosù tā dōu zhǐ dào dù chéng liàng gōngjù de péng shàngqù le .
pairs.english: He pointed toward the roofs twice. Wenxiu woke and told him both times he had pointed at Du Cheng's tool-drying shed.
pairs.hanzi: 他朝那排屋顶点了两回，温岫醒来，告诉他都指到杜澄晾工具的棚上去了。

pairs.target: shí bèi jiēhuò de ān míng shì gè sǎngyīn hěn dī de nǚrén . tā yì shǒutí zhe shuǐtǒng , yìshǒu ná yàoshi , jiàn wēn xiù cóng tóushàng bá xià gāng chāhuíqù de zānzǐ , biàn wènlù shìbushì hái diān .
pairs.english: Shibei's receiver Anming was a woman with a very low voice. Carrying a bucket in one hand and keys in the other, she saw Wenxiu remove her newly replaced hairpin and asked whether the road was still bumpy.
pairs.hanzi: 石背接货的安茗是个嗓音很低的女人。她一手提着水桶，一手拿钥匙，见温岫从头上拔下刚插回去的簪子，便问路是不是还颠。

pairs.target: wēn xiù shuō bù diān , zìjǐ zhǐshì xiǎng kànkàn biérén xiū de qiáo , ān míng ǹg le yìshēng , méi tì tā bǎ huǎng shuō yuán .
pairs.english: Wenxiu said no, she had only wanted to examine someone else's bridge. Anming murmured without helping her complete the lie.
pairs.hanzi: 温岫说不颠，自己只是想看看别人修的桥，安茗嗯了一声，没替她把谎说圆。

pairs.target: tāmen cóng jiē fáng zǒujìn hòuyuàn , dìshàng búshì děngdài guò gǔ de xīnhuò , érshì yíluò luò dǎokòu de kōngxiāng .
pairs.english: They went from the receiving office into the back yard. On the ground were not new goods waiting to cross the valley but stacks of upturned empty crates.
pairs.hanzi: 他们从接房走进后院，地上不是等待过谷的新货，而是一摞摞倒扣的空箱。

pairs.target: dà de tào xiǎo de , xiǎo de lǐmiàn yòu sāi zhe chāi xià de báogébǎn , yǒuxiē lián gàizi yě xiè le , jǐzhī xiāng biàn néng zhàn yìzhī xiāng de dìfāng .
pairs.english: Large ones nested smaller ones, with removed thin partitions tucked inside; some even had lids taken off, so several crates could occupy the space of one.
pairs.hanzi: 大的套小的，小的里面又塞着拆下的薄隔板，有些连盖子也卸了，几只箱便能占一只箱的地方。

pairs.target: liǎnggè rén zhèngzài kǔn , shéng rào dào nǎ yìcéng , biàn yǒurén bǎ shàngmiàn nà céng fúzhù .
pairs.english: Two people were binding them; wherever the rope reached, someone steadied the layer above.
pairs.hanzi: 两个人正在捆，绳绕到哪一层，便有人把上面那层扶住。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zài fēng zhàn liáng guò de nà lèi cháng xiāng yě zài qízhōng , xiāng yán yǒu tóngyàng de bǔdīng .
pairs.english: The kind of long crate Tavi had measured in Wind Trestle was among them too, with the same repair nails on its rim.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维在风栈量过的那类长箱也在其中，箱沿有同样的补钉。

pairs.target: tā hái méi dūnxià , ān míng biàn jiào tā xiān kàn hòumiàn : zuórì bàn bān hòu suí kōng xiāng sònglái de kuān tuōjià , kōng zhe bǎizài liǎngzhī xiāng zhījiān , zěnme yě tào bú jìn lìngyìzhī .
pairs.english: Before he crouched, Anming told him to look behind first: the wide cradle sent back with the empty carriage after yesterday's half shift sat between two crates, unable to nest inside another.
pairs.hanzi: 他还没蹲下，安茗便叫他先看后面：昨日半班后随空厢送来的宽托架，空着摆在两只箱之间，怎么也套不进另一只。

pairs.target: " láishí néng tuō , huí shí zhàn dìfāng . " tā shuō .
pairs.english: “It supports on the way here, takes space on the way back,” she said.
pairs.hanzi: “来时能托，回时占地方。”她说。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng bǎ dàilái de tújuàn kāi , wèn wǎngcháng yìxiāng sòng jǐzhī kōngxiāng . ān míng bào le liǎngzhǒng zhuāng fǎ , yòu jiào zhèngzài kǔn de rén fàngmàn yìdiǎn , ràng tāmen kàn gàibǎn hé gé piàn zěnyàng shōu .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng unrolled his drawing and asked how many empty crates usually went in one carriage. Anming gave two loading arrangements and asked the binders to slow down so they could see how lids and partitions were packed.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡把带来的图卷开，问往常一厢送几只空箱。安茗报了两种装法，又叫正在捆的人放慢一点，让他们看盖板和隔片怎样收。

pairs.target: nàxiē cóng chūhuò yìtóu kàn qù xiàng suíshǒu sāijìn de kòngxì , zhèbiān què měiyícùn dōu yǒuyòng , búshì bǎ xiāngzǐ xièwán biàn shénme dōu méishèng .
pairs.english: Gaps that looked casually filled from the outgoing end had a use for every inch here. Unloading a crate did not leave nothing behind.
pairs.hanzi: 那些从出货一头看去像随手塞进的空隙，这边却每一寸都有用，不是把箱子卸完便什么都没剩。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiāng yàng kuàng kào zài qiángbiān , gēnzhāo shù le yìhuí . tā fāxiànzìjǐ yuánlái huà de tú , dào xiāngzǐ guò le fēn huòjià biàn tíngzhù le , lián chāixiàlái de gàizi wǎng nǎlǐ fàng yě méi huà .
pairs.english: Tavi leaned his gauge frame against the wall and counted along once. He realized his drawing had stopped when the crate passed the sorting rack, without even showing where removed lids went.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维将样框靠在墙边，跟着数了一回。他发现自己原来画的图，到箱子过了分货架便停住了，连拆下来的盖子往哪里放也没画。

pairs.target: ān míng wèn nà fù xīn jià ruò yóu zhèbiān lìngzhuāng yìxiāng sònghuí , yùnfèi yìng jì dào shuí míngxià , wēn xiù zhècì méiyǒu lìkè shuō shěng xià de gōngshí .
pairs.english: Anming asked whose account should bear the freight if the new cradle needed a separate carriage home. This time Wenxiu did not immediately mention saved work hours.
pairs.hanzi: 安茗问那副新架若由这边另装一厢送回，运费应记到谁名下，温岫这次没有立刻说省下的工时。

pairs.target: tā dūnxià chákàn tuōjià , wèn néng bunéng chāichéng liǎngjiàn . ruǎn héng yáotóu , shuō nà dé chóngxīn yàn , bié wèile huí xiāng biàn bǎ zuórì cái hé guò de chéng lì héngmù chāi le .
pairs.english: She crouched to examine the cradle and asked if it could split into two pieces. Ruan Heng shook his head: that would need fresh checks; don't dismantle the load-bearing crosspiece verified only yesterday just for the return crates.
pairs.hanzi: 她蹲下查看托架，问能不能拆成两件。阮衡摇头，说那得重新验，别为了回箱便把昨日才核过的承力横木拆了。

pairs.target: ān míng zài pángtīng wán , ràng tāmen xiān liú zhe yuányàng , jīntiān lái de rén yòu búshì bìxū tí zhe yígè piàoliang bànfǎ huíqù .
pairs.english: Listening beside them, Anming told them to leave it unchanged for now; visitors today were not obliged to take home a beautiful solution.
pairs.hanzi: 安茗在旁听完，让他们先留着原样，今天来的人又不是必须提着一个漂亮办法回去。

pairs.target: yuànlǐ de xiǎomén bèi tuīkāi , yígè háizi duān zhe yìwǎn bāo hǎo de dòuzǐ jìnlái , jiàoān míng xiān ná zìjǐ nà fèn .
pairs.english: The yard's small gate opened and a child came in with a bowl of shelled beans, telling Anming to take her portion first.
pairs.hanzi: 院里的小门被推开，一个孩子端着一碗剥好的豆子进来，叫安茗先拿自己那份。

pairs.target: tā cóng wǎn lǐ zhuā le yìbǎ , yúxià de sāijìn jiē fáng , ràng háizi qù hǎn rén , bié zhǐgù zhǎo tā .
pairs.english: She took a handful from the bowl and sent the rest into the receiving office, telling the child to call everyone rather than only finding her.
pairs.hanzi: 她从碗里抓了一把，余下的塞进接房，让孩子去喊人，别只顾找她。

pairs.target: wēn xiù shēnshǒu xiǎng ná , háizi bǎ wǎn táigāo , shuō tā shàng huí shuō zhī cháng yìkē , zuìhòu lián dǐxià de yándōu tiǎn le .
pairs.english: Wenxiu reached for some, but the child lifted the bowl, saying she had promised one taste last time and licked even the salt at the bottom.
pairs.hanzi: 温岫伸手想拿，孩子把碗抬高，说她上回说只尝一颗，最后连底下的盐都舔了。

pairs.target: " nà shì suānméi . " wēn xiù shuō . " fǎnzhèng dōu shì nǐ . " tǎ wéi rěnbúzhù xiào , chèn liǎng rén zhēng zhè jù huà , jiāng tuōjià pángbiān de xiāngdǐ lìng huà le yìzhāng .
pairs.english: “Those were sour plums,” Wenxiu said. “It was still you.” Tavi could not help laughing and, while they argued, drew the crate base beside the cradle separately.
pairs.hanzi:
“那是酸梅。”温岫说。
“反正都是你。”
塔维忍不住笑，趁两人争这句话，将托架旁边的箱底另画了一张。

pairs.target: zhèhuí tā huà dào huíchéng , xiěxià tuōjià bùnéng tàozhuāng , suǒ xū xiāng shù wèi jì , méi zài xiàmiàn tiān yìháng zìjǐ shàng bù zhīdào de shěngqián shù .
pairs.english: This time he drew the return journey too, noting that the cradle could not nest and carriage requirements remained uncounted, without adding savings he did not yet know below.
pairs.hanzi: 这回他画到回程，写下托架不能套装，所需厢数未计，没在下面添一行自己尚不知道的省钱数。

pairs.target: wǔhòu , ān míng ràng rén àn yuánlái de tào xiāng fǎ sòngzǒu yìxiāng , tuōjià zé liúzài cè wū , děng tāmen shāngliáng rúhé àn yuányàng zhōuzhuǎn . méiyǒu shuí wèile ràng zhè zhāng xīn tú xiǎnde guǎnyòng , yìng wǎng xiāng lǐ zài sāi yíjiàn .
pairs.english: That afternoon Anming sent off one carriage with the original nested-crate arrangement, leaving the cradle in a side room until they decided how to circulate it intact. Nobody forced in another piece just to make the new drawing look useful.
pairs.hanzi: 午后，安茗让人按原来的套箱法送走一厢，托架则留在侧屋，等他们商量如何按原样周转。没有谁为了让这张新图显得管用，硬往厢里再塞一件。

pairs.target: huíqù de chēshàng , wēn xiù méi shuì . tā hé ruǎn héng shuōqǐ liǎngtóu gè liú yífù tuōjià de kěnéng , yào tiān duōshǎo mùliào , shuí lái jiǎnchá kōng jià , huà jiǎng dào shíqiáo shàng hái méiwán .
pairs.english: On the cart back, Wenxiu did not sleep. She and Ruan Heng discussed keeping a cradle at each end: how much extra timber, who would inspect the empty cradles. They were still talking at the stone bridge.
pairs.hanzi: 回去的车上，温岫没睡。她和阮衡说起两头各留一副托架的可能，要添多少木料，谁来检查空架，话讲到石桥上还没完。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi cóng liǎng rén de kòngxì wàngchūqù , qiáoxià de shuǐliú xiàng bǐ láishí kàndéqīng , xiānqián cáng zhe de nà yíduàn rújīn jiù zài yǎnqián .
pairs.english: Tavi looked out between them; the water's direction beneath the bridge was clearer than on the way over, and the stretch hidden before was now in plain sight.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维从两人的空隙望出去，桥下的水流向比来时看得清，先前藏着的那一段如今就在眼前。

pairs.target: gǎndào fēng zhàn shí , jiē fáng de dēng hái liàng zhe . dù chéng zài ménwài děng tāmen , jiàn ān míng tuìhuílái de zhàng tiáo , xiān méi wèn nàbiān shìbushì tiāomáobìng , zhī wèn yǒuméiyǒu suàn shàng huí xiāng .
pairs.english: When they reached Wind Trestle, the receiving office light was still on. Du Cheng waited outside, saw Anming's returned account slip and first asked not whether the other side was being difficult, but whether they had counted return crates.
pairs.hanzi: 赶到风栈时，接房的灯还亮着。杜澄在门外等他们，见安茗退回来的账条，先没问那边是不是挑毛病，只问有没有算上回箱。

pairs.target: tā jiāng sāngè rén ràng jìnwū , shuō zhuǎnyùn huì de dáfù yě dào le , jìrán dōu méi chīwǎnfàn , xiān bǎ huà tīng wán , bié děng míngrì gèzì yòu cāi yíbiàn .
pairs.english: He ushered all three inside, saying the association's answer had arrived too. Since none had eaten dinner, hear it first rather than spend tomorrow guessing separately again.
pairs.hanzi: 他将三个人让进屋，说转运会的答复也到了，既然都没吃晚饭，先把话听完，别等明日各自又猜一遍。
